subject: Procurement intake: vendor portal exception & payment route plan - MountainTide Health
messages:
From: Erin Summers <erin@mountaintide.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement@mountaintide.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo procurement questions + intake form

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Procurement asked me to kick off the vendor intake so they can decide whether to pay via PO or procurement card. Two quick asks to help them triage:

1) Can you confirm what supporting documents Redwood needs for vendor setup (W-9 vs W-8, bank ACH stub, proof of insurance)?
2) Does Redwood accept marketplace purchases (AWS Marketplace/GCP Marketplace) or do we need a direct PO?

I've attached MountainTide's standard intake stub so our procurement team can fill any missing fields (MT_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx). If a marketplace path is viable we can move faster, otherwise we'll plan for a PO.

Could you also share a short mutual action plan with owners/timelines so I can escalate internally?

Thanks —
Erin Summers
Head of Procurement
MountainTide Health

Attachment: MT_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Erin Summers <erin@mountaintide.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo procurement questions + intake form

Erin —

Appreciate the clear list and the intake form. Quick answers up front:

- Documents: W-9 (US entities) OR W-8BEN-E (foreign entities), ACH or bank-letter for banking details if you want electronic payments, and we request basic insurance certs only on enterprise contracts. For starter onboarding we only need the W-9 + banking stub to set up invoices.
- Marketplaces: We support AWS Marketplace in most cases, but it depends on the licensing & pricing model you need. If MountainTide must centralize via your marketplace procurement card, that can be fastest; otherwise PO billing to MountainTide Finance works.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Tue 24 Nov: MountainTide returns intake form + W-9 (owner: Erin)
- Wed 25 Nov: Redwood finance triages tax forms, flags any missing banking info (owner: Ben)
- Fri 27 Nov: Decision on PO vs marketplace; if PO selected, Redwood issues initial contract and invoice flow (owner: Neha)
- Mon 30 Nov: Vendor portal/onboarding kickoff (owner: Tessa)

I've attached our vendor packet and a redlined payment-terms doc for your procurement to review. If you prefer, Ben is happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call to walk procurement through banking fields we need.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0198
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, redlined_payment_terms.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RE: Post-demo procurement questions + intake form

Neha —

Forwarding Erin's intake + Tessa's proposed plan. Procurement has indicated they prefer PO routing (MountainTide standard). Two points from finance to confirm before we send the contract: 

- They will need invoices addressed to: MountainTide Health, Inc., Attn: AP, 120 Harbor Way, Suite 200. Can you confirm if our billing step will accept that exact legal name and address?
- Payment route: PO with net-30 seems fine, but they asked whether we can accept ACH and whether we can auto-map invoices if they enroll via marketplace. If procurement insists on a vendor portal exception (they don't want marketplace), we'll need to flag one-time setup for AP.

I left a couple inline comments in the redlined_payment_terms.docx about invoice headers and remittance instructions. Happy to take this on — I can prep the vendor setup ticket for finance once we have the W-9.

—Ben
